title: microlaena distichophylla
intro: Microlaena distichophylla, commonly known as Poverty Grass or Long-leaved Microlaena, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, sore throats, and coughs, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Microlaena distichophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Microlaena distichophylla include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
